Valmont depot: 62 vehicles, 140 drivers, 8 lifts, certified June 2023 (renewal due June 2028). Operations lead Halvard Onstad; night supervisor Teodora Blaskovic. Average 410 daily departures, winter peak 530; 1.8% cancellations. Night shift understaffed.

February 2025: brake line failure grounded nine vehicles four days; cause unestablished. Brake checks every 6,000 km. September 2024: cloned fuel cards lost €4,200. Rules: fuel card second approval above €200; route changes need seven days' notice; incidents filed within 24 hours; parts above €500 need two quotations; rosters need one named publisher.

Electrification study approved but unfunded; second charging bay due Q3. Old ticketing terminal on three routes. Parts contract renegotiated November 2025; supplier contact Ingrid Solheim. Training: 11 days, revised April 2026. Winter peak capacity unmodelled.
